title: docs(pm-dispatch): give `domain:spec-tooling` its table row — contested paths split by the "orbits the spec contract" criterion (#5469)
body:
Part of #5469 — this lands the half that PR #6886 explicitly escalated instead of implementing: the `domain:spec-tooling` / `domain:devx` boundary. **The maintainer ruled on 2026-08-09 (in session, relayed to #5469 in a comment): criterion split.** The lane gets its row; the three contested paths are divided by whether the work orbits the spec contract.

## What changed

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, docs-only:

1. **New `domain:spec-tooling` row** in the domain table, after `spec-surface`:
   - Uncontested surface listed outright: `packages/spec/scripts/**`, `packages/spec/docs/**` — paths `devx` never claimed (seat card #6018).
   - The three contested paths (`packages/lint`, `scripts/`, `content/docs/**`) are **criterion-split** with `devx`: contract gates / generators / lint rules / error prose / the references pipeline route to `spec-tooling`; general dev tooling stays `devx`. Ruling cited inline (2026-08-09, #5469).
   - Red lines carried over verbatim from #5163/#6018: ⛔ never `packages/spec/src/**/*.zod.ts`, never the strictness ledger.
2. **`devx` row** gains the matching carve-out note pointing at the `spec-tooling` row.
3. **"`spec` split" section**: "one package, two seats" corrected to **three seats** (semantic / text / machine face), and the boundary bullet now records the ruling so the row has a traceable origin, same as every other split in that section.

## Why now

The lane has been real for days while the table had no row: seat card #6018 occupied through a handover (9 PRs landed in one term), program card #5163, triage still applying the label (#6945 on 2026-08-09), 10+ open issues, two in flight. A lane statistics pass requested by the maintainer surfaced the gap; the maintainer then ruled the boundary question that #6886 had escalated.

## Coordination with in-flight PR #6886

#6886 (session `session_01F8q5J1MQyocgtNspb15fSn`, branch `claude/issue-5469-domain-label-vocabulary`) adds the `domain:*` roster and deliberately left the table row out *because* the three paths were unruled. That premise is now resolved, not contradicted: this PR adds only the row + boundary text and does not touch the roster section, so overlap is at most an adjacent-hunk rebase. A comment on #5469 records the ruling for that session to pick up.

## Gates

`check:skill-frame-sync` ✓ (4 copies isomorphic, 3 axes — this change touches neither the frame nor the published mirror, which stays deliberately generalized per #5451 route B), `check:skill-compatibility-version` ✓. Releases nothing → `skip-changeset` label per the Check Changeset gate's route 2; the empty-frontmatter changeset initially included was removed after the gate correctly rejected it as a real (and stalling, #4898) input to changesets/action.
